description: Find published driving-school profiles and bookable individual services for a Swiss town. Reuses DriveLab location coverage and ordering. Prices are per listed service; fees and final total are checked on the website. Use get_lesson_availability with returned instructor_id and service_id for free slots. Does not book.

city.description: Swiss town name or canonical town slug, for example Zürich, zuerich, Zug, Luzern.

language.description: Response and checkout language; does not filter the teaching language. Default de.

teaching_language.description: Only offers taught in this language. Omit to see all teaching languages.

name: search_driving_lessons
title: Find driving lessons
